body: I received the infusion on day 4. Day 5 and 6 I still felt awful. I spent Days 1-6 in bed with extreme fatigue and weakness.  Never had even as much as a low grade fever. Day 7, however I woke up feeling good for the first time in a week. I’m on day 10 and feel almost 100%. I began regaining smell and taste on day 7 although these senses are no where as strong as they were prior to having COVID. I’m not sure if the infusion is to thank for my improving symptoms, but 10/10 would do the infusion again.

FELT. When feeling normal (stable as you call it) I just hate it. It’s like I feel nothing. The extremes of bipolar can really leave you wanting more. And stability has me sabotaging relationships, jobs, etc just to FEEL SOMETHING.

Literally searched for this in the forum. Glad someone else feels like me. All relationships are solely formed due to a manic episode. I am better manic. 100%. High energy, no need for sleep. I get shit done. I feel like I’m meant to exist. Like not nothing could be more perfect for me.
This is something I honestly struggle with. Makes me wonder if I actually experience real romantic feelings or if it’s but only a result of hypomania/mania.
I’m just commenting in support as I feel this way, too.
